question_cn: 彼得罗夫防御中黑方有机会兑换，但必须按正确顺序操作，否则反而吃亏。为什么兑换顺序至关重要？
question_en: In the Petrov, why can the order of exchanges determine whether Black gains or loses?

options.text_cn: 兑换顺序不重要，结果相同
options.text_en: The order of exchanges does not matter; the result is the same.

options.text_cn: 错误顺序可能让对方在中间插入一步强棋（如将军或攻击），使兑换变成吃亏
options.text_en: The opponent may insert a strong intermediate move, such as a check or attack, turning the exchange sequence against you.

options.text_cn: 兑换顺序只影响美观，不影响实际局势
options.text_en: Move order affects appearance but not the actual position.

options.text_cn: 应该先兑换价值低的棋子，再兑换价值高的
options.text_en: Always exchange the least valuable pieces first.

explanation_cn: 兑换顺序（Move Order）是中高级棋手最容易忽视的细节。错误顺序的陷阱：若先走A再走B，对方可能在A之后插入一步强棋（中间着，Zwischenzug）打乱你的计划；而若先走B再走A，对方没有这个插入机会。彼得罗夫中黑方若兑换顺序错误，白方可以插入致命的中间着得子或获得决定性优势。正确方法：在执行兑换序列前，逐步确认对方在每一步之间是否有反击手段。
explanation_en: Move order matters because the opponent may have an intermediate move, or zwischenzug, between exchanges. A check or attack can disrupt the planned sequence and win material or gain a decisive advantage. Before starting an exchange sequence, check what the opponent can do after each individual move.
